extracted.name: Tuna Salad with Eggs and Pickles
extracted.description: My husband says this tuna salad with eggs and pickles is even better than his mother's. It's mild with a nice blend of flavors.
instruction_lines: Mix tuna, eggs, onion, and celery together in a large bowl.

Mix mayonnaise, relish, honey mustard, celery seed, seasoned salt, and pepper together in a small bowl; pour over tuna mixture and stir gently until all ingredients are coated. Serve immediately, or cover and chill until ready to serve.
